instruction: Look at dual_pocket_bracket.step. For this workflow, open the part in FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad`, then carry out the Path workbench edits when working on `dual_pocket_bracket.step`. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job. Use T1 for Adaptive or Pocket Shape roughing on the two top pockets. Use T2 for pocket finish passes and an outside Profile finishing operation. The pocket floor must be Z=6.000 mm and the outside profile must machine down to Z=0.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 10 mm end mill for Adaptive/Pocket roughing; T2 is a 6 mm end mill for pocket and outside Profile finishing. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-7.nc.
